subproblem.title: Deformation of the shells and summation of the deformed series (Simon 6.5.1, (11)–(25))
subproblem.statement: Deformation of a decomposed current and summation of the deformed series (Simon Ch. 6, proof of 5.1, displays (11)–(25)). Assume, as a hypothesis of the statement, (VO): the frozen type of Submission.dtc_vanish_off_support (S(ω) = 0 whenever tsupport ω is disjoint from spt S). Let P, m ∈ ℕ and let push_k(F, X) ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^P), homot_k(F, G, X) ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^P) be operations (k ∈ ℕ, F, G : ℝ^P → ℝ^P, X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^P), domain univ) satisfying (PF), the conclusion of the frozen type of the parent's sibling Submission.cmcdt_lipschitz_pushforward_homotopy for this P (taken verbatim as a hypothesis): calling X normal with compact support (NC) when spt X is compact, M(X) < ∞ and boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ (= M(∂X) for k ≥ 1, 0 for k = 0), for all Λ ∈ ℝ≥0, all Λ-Lipschitz F, G, F', G' and all NC X, Y of degree k: (1) push_k(id, X) = X; (2) push_k(F, X − Y) = push_k(F, X) − push_k(F, Y) and homot_k(F, G, X − Y) = homot_k(F, G, X) − homot_k(F, G, Y); (3) if F = F' and G = G' on spt X then push_k(F, X) = push_k(F', X) and homot_k(F, G, X) = homot_k(F', G', X); (4) M(push_k(F, X)) ≤ Λ^k M(X), spt push_k(F, X) ⊆ F(spt X), M(homot_k(F, G, X)) ≤ δ(2Λ)^k M(X) whenever δ ∈ ℝ and |F(x) − G(x)| ≤ δ for x ∈ spt X, and spt homot_k(F, G, X) ⊆ {F(x) + t(G(x) − F(x)) : x ∈ spt X, t ∈ [0, 1]}; (5) for X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^P) with compact support, M(X) < ∞, M(∂X) < ∞: ∂ push_{k+1}(F, X) = push_k(F, ∂X), push_{k+1}(G, X) − push_{k+1}(F, X) − homot_k(F, G, ∂X) = ∂ homot_{k+1}(F, G, X), and if X is integer multiplicity then push_{k+1}(F, X) and homot_{k+1}(F, G, X) are integer multiplicity; (6) for X ∈ 𝒟_0(ℝ^P) with compact support and finite mass, push_0(G, X) − push_0(F, X) = ∂ homot_0(F, G, X). Assume also (IMS), the conclusion of the frozen type of the parent's sibling Submission.cmcdt_im_series for this P (taken verbatim as a hypothesis): for every k ∈ ℕ and all W_i ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^P) (i ∈ ℕ, domain univ) with Σ_i M(W_i) < ∞ (tsum in [0, ∞]) there is S ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^P) such that: for every test form ω, the series Σ_i W_i(ω) has sum S(ω) (HasSum); M(S) ≤ Σ_i M(W_i); spt S ⊆ closure(⋃_i spt W_i); and if every W_i is integer multiplicity then S is integer multiplicity. Let T ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P), W_j ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P), D_j, Z_j ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P), φ_j : ℝ^P → ℝ^P, Λ_j ∈ ℝ≥0 (j ∈ ℕ), δ ∈ ℝ and L, A, A' ⊆ ℝ^P, and assume: Σ_j W_j(ω) = T(ω) (HasSum) for every ω; ∂W_0 = D_0 − Z_0 and ∂W_{j+1} = D_{j+1} − (Z_{j+1} − Z_j); every W_j is integer multiplicity; spt W_j, spt D_j, spt Z_j are compact, M(W_j), M(∂W_j), M(D_j), M(Z_j) < ∞ and boundaryMassOn D_j ℝ^P, boundaryMassOn Z_j ℝ^P < ∞; φ_j is Λ_j-Lipschitz, 1 ≤ Λ_j ≤ Λ_{j+1}; φ_{j+1} = φ_j on spt Z_j; dist(φ_j(x), x) ≤ δ for x ∈ spt W_j ∪ spt D_j ∪ spt Z_j; L is closed and φ_j(x) ∈ L for x ∈ spt W_j; spt W_j ⊆ A and spt D_j ⊆ A'; Σ_j (2Λ_j)^{m+1}M(W_j) < ∞, Σ_j (2Λ_j)^m M(D_j) < ∞ and (2Λ_j)^m M(Z_j) → 0 (in [0, ∞]). Then there are Q₀ ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P), R₁ ∈ 𝒟_{m+2}(ℝ^P), S₁ ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P) with: Q₀ and R₁ integer multiplicity; T − Q₀ − S₁ = ∂R₁; spt Q₀ ⊆ L ∩ cthickening(δ, A), spt R₁ ⊆ cthickening(δ, A), spt ∂Q₀ ⊆ cthickening(δ, A'), spt S₁ ⊆ cthickening(δ, A') (Metric.cthickening); M(Q₀) ≤ Σ_j (2Λ_j)^{m+1}M(W_j), M(∂Q₀) ≤ Σ_j (2Λ_j)^m M(D_j), M(R₁) ≤ δ·Σ_j (2Λ_j)^{m+1}M(W_j) and M(S₁) ≤ δ·Σ_j (2Λ_j)^m M(D_j) (δ read as ENNReal.ofReal δ). Conventions: ℝ^P = Euclid P (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P)); for U ⊆ ℝ^P, 𝒟^k(U) = TestFormOn U k (smooth k-forms on ℝ^P whose compact tsupport lies in U) and 𝒟_k(U) = GeometricCurrentOn U k (SimonGMT Chapter06), X(ω) the value of X on ω; X − Y is the contract subtraction, (X − Y)(ω) = X(ω) − Y(ω) (definitional); 0 is the zero current; ∂X = X.boundary, ∂X(η) = X(dη) (GeometricCurrentOn.boundary_apply, dη = exteriorDerivativeTestOn U k η, whose underlying form is exteriorDerivative η); currents are equal when their values agree (GeometricCurrentOn.ext). |α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α is the Euclidean coefficient norm of a covector. M_G(X) = X.massOn G ∈ [0, ∞] is the supremum of ENNReal.ofReal X(ω) over the ω ∈ 𝒟^k(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ G and |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x (such ω are admissible for M_G, massAdmissibleOn U k G); M(X) = X.mass = M_U(X); boundaryMassOn X G = M_G(∂X) if k ≥ 1 and 0 if k = 0. spt X = X.support (Simon 6.2.11) = U minus the zero region, the union of the open W with compact closure contained in U on which X vanishes (X(ω) = 0 whenever tsupport ω ⊆ W). IM = IsIntegerMultiplicity: X is represented by an IMRep R = (M, θ, ξ) of the contract (R.carrier, R.mult, R.orient), i.e. X(ω) = R.action ω = ∫_M θ⟨ω, ξ⟩ dHⁿ, and R.measure = θ·Hⁿ⌞M (Hⁿ = μHE[n]).

subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: steps 7–9 of the parent's supplied proof (Simon Ch. 6, proof of 5.1, displays (11)–(25), chapter-06.txt lines 1405–1928), with the homotopy taken from φ_j to the identity (F := φ_j, G := id in (PF)), so that the homotopy currents enter with the sign needed for T − Q₀ − S₁ = ∂R₁ and no negation of currents is required. Siblings used: S = cmcsd_support_calculus, MS = cmc_fc_cs_massOn_sub_le, EB = cmr_abs_apply_le_massOn.

Notation. All currents are on univ = ℝ^P; M(X) = M_{ℝ^P}(X); id := (x ↦ x). PF1, …, PF6 are the six conjuncts of (PF): PF1 push_k(id, X) = X; PF2 linearity of push_k(F, ·) and homot_k(F, G, ·) on differences; PF3 locality; PF4 mass bounds M(push_k(F, X)) ≤ Λ^k M(X) and M(homot_k(F, G, X)) ≤ δ'(2Λ)^k M(X) when dist(F x, G x) ≤ δ' on spt X, and support bounds spt push_k(F, X) ⊆ F(spt X), spt homot_k(F, G, X) ⊆ {F(x) + t(G(x) − F(x)) : x ∈ spt X, t ∈ [0, 1]}; PF5 for X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1} with compact support, M(X), M(∂X) < ∞: ∂push_{k+1}(F, X) = push_k(F, ∂X), push_{k+1}(G, X) − push_{k+1}(F, X) − homot_k(F, G, ∂X) = ∂homot_{k+1}(F, G, X), and integrality of push_{k+1}(F, X), homot_{k+1}(F, G, X) for IM X (PF6 is not used). PF1–PF4 require X (and Y) to be NC_k: compact support, finite mass and boundaryMassOn X ℝ^P < ∞; maps must be Λ-Lipschitz for one common Λ. For a test form ω, c_ω := sup_x |ω(x)| < ∞ (x ↦ |ω(x)| is continuous and vanishes outside the compact tsupport ω), and dω denotes the exterior-derivative test form, so ∂X(ω) = X(dω).

0. (Preliminaries.)
   (0a) φ_j is Λ_j- and Λ_{j+1}-Lipschitz (Λ_j ≤ Λ_{j+1}, LipschitzWith.weaken); id is 1-Lipschitz, hence Λ_j- and Λ_{j+1}-Lipschitz (1 ≤ Λ_j ≤ Λ_{j+1}).
   (0b) W_j ∈ NC_{m+1} (for degree m + 1, boundaryMassOn W_j ℝ^P = M(∂W_j) by definition); D_j, Z_j ∈ NC_m (hypotheses).
   (0c) Z_{j+1} − Z_j ∈ NC_m: spt(Z_{j+1} − Z_j) ⊆ spt Z_{j+1} ∪ spt Z_j (S (iii)), a compact set, and spt(Z_{j+1} − Z_j) is closed (S (ii)), hence compact; M(Z_{j+1} − Z_j) ≤ M(Z_{j+1}) + M(Z_j) < ∞ (MS); for m = 0 boundaryMassOn of a 0-current is 0, and for m ≥ 1, ∂(Z_{j+1} − Z_j) = ∂Z_{j+1} − ∂Z_j (ext), so its mass is ≤ M(∂Z_{j+1}) + M(∂Z_j) < ∞ (MS).
   (0d) (Evaluation.) If M(X) < ∞ then |X(ω)| ≤ c_ω·M(X).toReal (EB with W := ℝ^P, tsupport ω ⊆ ℝ^P). Hence M(X_N) → 0 implies X_N(ω) → 0 (ENNReal.toReal is continuous at 0), and Σ_j M(X_j) < ∞ implies Σ_j |X_j(ω)| < ∞ (ENNReal.summable_toReal), so (X_j(ω))_j is summable (Summable.of_norm_bounded).
1. (Deformed pieces.) V_j := push_{m+1}(φ_j, W_j), H_j := homot_{m+1}(φ_j, id, W_j) ∈ 𝒟_{m+2}, Y_j := push_m(φ_j, D_j), E′_j := homot_m(φ_j, id, D_j) ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}, L′_j := push_m(φ_j, Z_j), K_j := homot_m(φ_j, id, Z_j) ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}.
2. (Locality.) PF3 with Λ := Λ_{j+1}, F := φ_{j+1}, G := id, F' := φ_j, G' := id (all Λ_{j+1}-Lipschitz by (0a)), X := Z_j ∈ NC_m and φ_{j+1} = φ_j on spt Z_j (hypothesis), id = id: push_m(φ_{j+1}, Z_j) = L′_j and homot_m(φ_{j+1}, id, Z_j) = K_j.
3. (Deforming the boundaries.) PF2 with Λ := Λ_0, F := φ_0, G := id and ∂W_0 = D_0 − Z_0 (D_0, Z_0 ∈ NC_m): push_m(φ_0, ∂W_0) = Y_0 − L′_0 and homot_m(φ_0, id, ∂W_0) = E′_0 − K_0. PF2 with Λ := Λ_{j+1}, F := φ_{j+1}, G := id, applied to ∂W_{j+1} = D_{j+1} − (Z_{j+1} − Z_j) (D_{j+1}, Z_{j+1} − Z_j ∈ NC_m by (0b), (0c)) and then to Z_{j+1} − Z_j (Z_{j+1}, Z_j ∈ NC_m), together with step 2: push_m(φ_{j+1}, ∂W_{j+1}) = Y_{j+1} − (L′_{j+1} − L′_j) and homot_m(φ_{j+1}, id, ∂W_{j+1}) = E′_{j+1} − (K_{j+1} − K_j).
4. (Homotopy formula and integrality.) PF5 with k := m, Λ := Λ_j, F := φ_j, G := id and X := W_j (compact support, M(W_j), M(∂W_j) < ∞) gives
   (4a) ∂V_j = push_m(φ_j, ∂W_j);
   (4b) push_{m+1}(id, W_j) − V_j − homot_m(φ_j, id, ∂W_j) = ∂H_j, and push_{m+1}(id, W_j) = W_j by PF1 (W_j ∈ NC_{m+1}); hence W_j − V_j − homot_m(φ_j, id, ∂W_j) = ∂H_j;
   (4c) since W_j is IM, V_j and H_j are IM.
5. (Bounds; PF4 with Λ := Λ_j, F := φ_j, G := id, and δ, using dist(φ_j(x), id(x)) ≤ δ on spt W_j, spt D_j, spt Z_j.)
   (5a) M(V_j) ≤ Λ_j^{m+1}M(W_j) ≤ (2Λ_j)^{m+1}M(W_j); M(Y_j) ≤ Λ_j^m M(D_j) ≤ (2Λ_j)^m M(D_j); M(L′_j) ≤ (2Λ_j)^m M(Z_j); M(H_j) ≤ δ(2Λ_j)^{m+1}M(W_j); M(E′_j) ≤ δ(2Λ_j)^m M(D_j); M(K_j) ≤ δ(2Λ_j)^m M(Z_j) (δ read as ENNReal.ofReal δ; Λ_j ≤ 2Λ_j, pow_le_pow_left). Write Σ_W := Σ_j (2Λ_j)^{m+1}M(W_j) < ∞ and Σ_D := Σ_j (2Λ_j)^m M(D_j) < ∞. Then Σ_j M(V_j) ≤ Σ_W, Σ_j M(H_j) ≤ δ·Σ_W, Σ_j M(Y_j) ≤ Σ_D and Σ_j M(E′_j) ≤ δ·Σ_D, all finite (ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum, ENNReal.tsum_mul_left, ENNReal.mul_lt_top).
   (5b) M(L′_N) → 0 and M(K_N) → 0 as N → ∞: they are bounded by (2Λ_N)^m M(Z_N) → 0 and δ·(2Λ_N)^m M(Z_N) → δ·0 = 0 (ENNReal.Tendsto.const_mul, δ ≠ ∞), and squeezed below by 0.
